cases.title: Discard password on Never For This Site selection
cases.description: Select Never For This Site in the save password dialog box and verify that the browser discards the password.

cases.title: Discard password on Never For This Site during simultaneous prompts
cases.description: Select Never For This Site when multiple login prompts appear simultaneously and verify password is correctly discarded.

cases.title: Verify multiple saved credentials are available to be presented
cases.description: Save multiple username and password pairs for a website and verify all choices are available to be presented later.

cases.title: Verify credential presentation with exactly two credentials
cases.description: Save exactly two username and password pairs for a website and verify both choices are available to be presented.

cases.title: Update password for saved site
cases.description: Change the password for a site with saved credentials and verify that the password manager successfully picks up and stores the new password.

cases.title: Update password immediately after saving
cases.description: Update the password immediately after saving the initial credentials for a website and verify the password manager updates correctly.

cases.title: Disable password manager normal behavior
cases.description: Disable the password manager from the preferences panel and verify that the browser no longer asks to save passwords and no longer gets prefilled info on sites.

cases.title: Disable password manager with active prompt
cases.description: Disable the password manager from preferences while a save password prompt is currently active on screen to ensure proper dismissal and discontinuation of saving and prefilling.

cases.title: View saved username and password in preferences
cases.description: Save a username and password, then navigate to the password manager through preferences and verify the information is successfully viewed.

cases.title: View credentials with a large list of stored sites
cases.description: View saved credentials in the password manager through preferences when a very large list of stored sites is present.

cases.title: Remove specific username and password for a given site
cases.description: Remove a specific username and password for a given site and verify it no longer autofills and is removed from the password manager list.

cases.title: Remove the last remaining credential for a site
cases.description: Remove the last remaining credential for a site and verify complete removal of autofill capability and list presence.

cases.title: Remove all username and password information
cases.description: Remove all username and password information and verify no autofill occurs and nothing is listed in the password manager.

cases.title: Clear an already empty password manager database
cases.description: Attempt to remove all credentials when the password manager database is already empty and verify no errors occur and nothing is listed.

opinions.feedback: All proposed test cases are testable, distinct, and adequately address the requirements without any confirmed blockers.
All test cases are well-structured, adequately mapped to the requirements, and fully testable. No blockers identified.

analysis.analysis: R-102: Normal scenario: Select Never For This Site in the save password dialog box and verify password is discarded. Edge scenario: Select Never For This Site when multiple login prompts appear simultaneously. Boundary scenario: Immediate subsequent login attempt to the same site. Abnormal scenario: Network interruption while selecting the option. R-103: Normal scenario: Save multiple username and password pairs for a website and verify all choices are available to be presented later. Edge scenario: Save the maximum supported number of credentials for a single site. Boundary scenario: Exactly two credentials saved versus single credential. Abnormal scenario: Corrupted profile database containing multiple credentials. R-104: Normal scenario: Change password for a saved site and verify password manager picks up the new password. Edge scenario: Changing password to the exact same string as the old password. Boundary scenario: Updating password immediately after saving initial credentials. Abnormal scenario: Session timeout during password update submission. R-105: Normal scenario: Disable password manager from preferences and verify browser no longer asks to save passwords and stops prefilling info. Edge scenario: Disabling password manager while a save password prompt is currently active on screen. Boundary scenario: Navigating to a site immediately after disabling the feature. Abnormal scenario: Preference file write failure when disabling. R-106: Normal scenario: View saved username and password in the password manager through preferences. Edge scenario: Viewing credentials with a very large list of stored sites. Boundary scenario: Opening preferences immediately after saving a new credential. Abnormal scenario: Preferences panel failing to load storage backend. R-107: Normal scenario: Remove a specific username and password for a given site and verify it no longer autofills and is removed from the password manager list. Edge scenario: Removing the last remaining credential for a site. Boundary scenario: Removing a credential while autofill is actively attempting to trigger. Abnormal scenario: Deletion failure due to locked storage file. R-108: Normal scenario: Remove all username and password information and verify no autofill occurs and nothing is listed in the password manager. Edge scenario: Clearing an already empty password manager database. Boundary scenario: Removing all credentials when thousands are stored. Abnormal scenario: Partial deletion crash leaving orphaned entries.
